reference: GNU coreutils csplit, run by the harness with Bash as the reference shell, LC_ALL=C and the same fixture files; status (recorded on stdout), stdout, stderr bytes and the resulting files are compared with the candidate.
coverage: Pass 8 (G119, G120): usage and pattern errors exit 1 in GNU form; long options and clustered short options.

cases.purpose: G119: missing operands are usage errors with status 1.
cases.script:
printf 'a\nb\n' > cf
rc=0
csplit || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
csplit cf || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

cases.purpose: G119: an option missing its argument.
cases.script:
printf 'a\nb\n' > cf
rc=0
csplit -n || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
csplit -f || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
csplit -b || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

printf 'a\nb\n' > cf
rc=0
csplit -n x cf 1 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
csplit --digits=x cf 1 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

cases.purpose: G119: invalid patterns and a missing closing delimiter.
cases.script:
printf 'a\nb\n' > cf
rc=0
csplit cf "{3}" || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
csplit cf "/a" || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
csplit cf foo || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

cases.purpose: G119: clustered short options with an attached argument.
cases.script:
printf 'a\nb\n' > cf
rc=0
csplit -sk cf 1 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
csplit -sn1 cf 1 || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
ls xx* || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

cases.purpose: G120: unknown options name only csplit, status 1.
cases.script:
printf 'a\nb\n' > cf
rc=0
csplit -Y || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
csplit --bogus || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"

cases.purpose: Docker parity text/csplit-errors: pattern diagnostics quote the pattern in the locale's quotation marks, ASCII apostrophes in the C locale.
cases.script:
seq 1 5 > f
csplit f '/9/' 2>err || echo "rc=$?"; cat err >&2; n=0; for x in xx*; do [ -e "$x" ] && n=$((n+1)); done; echo "files=$n"
csplit -k f 2 '/9/' 2>err || echo "rc=$?"; cat err >&2; ls xx*; rm -f xx*
csplit f 9 2>err || echo "rc=$?"; cat err >&2
csplit f '%9%' 2>err || echo "rc=$?"; cat err >&2
csplit f '/1/' '{9}' 2>err || echo "rc=$?"; cat err >&2; rm -f xx*
